desc:
The Daodejing is one of the most translated texts in human history and one of the most contested. It has been read as a mystical treatise, a political manual, a guide to martial arts, a work of negative theology, and almost everything in between. Brook Ziporyn argues that the ambiguity is not a problem to be solved. It is the point.
